entry_conditions: The source container is upright and observable, the gripper is open or a prior close has plausible co-motion, and current measured joints admit the source-relative target. This policy is preferred for source table-pose displacement.
exit_conditions: Fingers are closed around the handle, the source co-moves with the TCP, the source is table-clear, and it is staged high above the bowl near the demonstrated relation with only a small initial tilt.
overlap_role: Every action in [180,360) is supervised for this policy and for controlled_pour_and_right, covering closed-gripper lift, upright carry, bowl staging, and the first small tilt.
successor_readiness: controlled_pour_and_right may receive after a clearly closed, co-moving, lifted source; nominal switching waits for the high bowl-relative stage.
failure_signatures: Do not hand off on closure alone. Stop or escalate if fingers remain open, TCP/handle alignment is wrong, the source fails to follow the TCP, particles move independently before secure lift, or IK reports nonconvergence or limit contact.
continuation_guidance: Resolve the source and bowl at every replan, retain two-frame history across switches, execute slots 1 through 8, and monitor finger width plus source/TCP co-motion. Use the TCP-delta prior for local intermediate-state errors and the phase-aware prior for ambiguous already-grasped entries.
limitations: Training contains successful nominal sequences only, with about 15 mm x and 12 mm y initial source spread and one bowl pose. Contact truth, missed-grasp recovery, slip recovery, large source rotations, and unreachable placements are not covered.
